policy.routing_precedence: Policy v2 request-risk rules override legacy taxonomy routing defaults.

independence.statement: The annotator independently authored all 80 labels from the permitted policy, taxonomy, and customer messages. Parent communication supplied sentiment schema literals and confirmed ambiguity/scope reason codes; it supplied no predictions, previous labels, or evaluation outputs. These are AI-authored development labels, not human gold and not unseen confirmation evidence.
independence.policy_document_timing: POLICY_V2.md was initially absent, became available during final verification, and was read before the labels were frozen. Its explicit discrimination/harm boundaries were applied before freezing. No implementation code or outputs were inspected.

conventions.secondary_intent: null unless a second substantive issue is recorded
conventions.media_only: true when unavailable media is essential to understand the requested outcome; ordinary links accompanying a described issue do not suffice
conventions.scope_reason_code_basis: Scope and ambiguity codes named by TAXONOMY.md and confirmed as compatible by the parent; mandatory-risk reason codes come from policy_v2.json.
conventions.uncertainty: Per-row notes make boundary interpretations explicit. Risk is not inferred merely from an intent name, account mention, repeated app failure, incidental profanity, or missing device detail.
conventions.eligibility: A false should_escalate label means the request has no mandatory policy veto under the authored interpretation. It does not guarantee that a candidate can produce an independently validated current supported answer.
